name: NotebookLM Batch - 9h
description: Process pending URLs with NotebookLM at 9am

then.prompt:
Execute the NotebookLM batch processor:

1. Run the script: batch-processor/process-pending-notebooklm.js
2. This will process all pending URLs in batch-processor/workdir/repo/mobile-share/pending/
3. Each URL will be added to NotebookLM and get a detailed French summary
4. Markdown fiches will be created in batch-processor/workdir/repo/fiches/
5. Everything will be committed to Git
6. Pull the changes in the Obsidian vault: git -C /Users/bertrand/Sites/fiches-veille pull origin main

IMPORTANT: Use the MCP NotebookLM tools (mcp_notebooklm_*) that are available in Kiro context.
